typography.headings: Cormorant Garamond, serif (for a dignified, traditional, and respectful tone)
typography.body: DM Sans, sans-serif (for highly legible UI elements, forms, and data)
typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings tight and body relaxed.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Trust (Saffron & Deep Blue)
colors.rules: Avoid generic SaaS blue. Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG contrast ratios against backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, ambient shadows for floating elements: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB for cards. Radii: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for buttons and seats.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 with 1px bottom border border-black/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain on hero background to reduce digital flatness.

components.header: Sticky header with backdrop-blur. Contains KBI and MBI logos paired together, and the event title. MUST have navigation (e.g., 'Pesan Tiket', 'Tentang Acara').
components.booking_stepper: Linear progression layout (Bento or Stacked Cards). Must have distinct sections: 1. Data Diri (Name, Phone), 2. Pilih Sesi (4 sessions), 3. Pilih Kursi, 4. Pembayaran.
components.seat_map: CSS Grid for seating. Add a curved 'LAYAR' (Screen) indicator at the top. Rows labeled A-K. Legend showing Available, Selected, Booked.
components.payment_card: Prominent display of Total + Unique Code (e.g., Rp 100.011). Tabs for QRIS and Bank Transfer (BCA 061 518 3381, PD Majelis Buddhayana Indonesia Prov Kepri). Prominent upload button for proof.
components.admin_dashboard: Clean, dense table layout. Shadcn table with columns for Order ID, Name, Phone, Session, Seats, Total, Proof Image, Actions (Verify/Reject).
components.printable_ticket: Minimalist card layout suitable for thermal or standard printing. Shows Name, Session, Seats, and Unique Code prominently.

grids.main_layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero content spans 8 cols, side info 4 cols.
grids.seat_grid: grid-cols-[auto_repeat(10,minmax(0,1fr))] or similar, adjusting for exact seat count per row. Gap-2 or gap-3.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. p-6 to p-12 for sections. Max-w-7xl mx-auto for containers.
layouts.mobile: Ensure seat map is horizontally scrollable on mobile devices (overflow-x-auto) to prevent layout breakage.

motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons (slight scale or color darken). Hover on available seats.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 for buttons/links. Avoid transition-all.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for booking steps to guide the user's eye.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must exceed 4.5:1 ratio. White text on Primary (#D56115) is accessible.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='seat-A1', data-testid='btn-submit-payment').

media.images: Use logos in headers. Use QRIS asset strictly in the payment section. Hero background should be dimmed with bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text readability.

3d_libraries: Not recommended for this transactional, community-focused app. Focus on clean 2D layout and fast load times.
instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia). Event Name: Nonton Bersama Film Dokumenter 'Y.A. MNS. Ashin Jinarakkhita: Jejak Langkah Sang Pelopor di Nusantara'.

Ticket price is Rp 50.000 per seat. When calculating total, multiply selected seats by 50000, then ADD a random 2-digit unique code (11-99). E.g. 2 seats = 100.000 + 11 = Rp 100.011. This helps admin verify exact transfers.
Implement 4 sequential sessions. Only one session can be booked at a time.
For the Seat Map: Create a visually clear 'LAYAR' (Screen) at the top. Use rows A-K. Make sure to track selected seats in an array. Display a legend (Tersedia, Terpilih, Terisi).
Payment Flow: Show total WITH unique code prominently. Users MUST upload a payment proof (image). Show a popup reminder to upload proof after checkout.
Admin Dashboard: Build a protected route for admins to view orders, see payment proof images, and Verify/Reject orders. Also include a 'Print Ticket' action.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, and use Shadcn for complex components like Dialogs, Inputs, Tables. Write components in .js files.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds over images for headers/navbars.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, avoiding muddy grays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-opacity).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or crisp slight rounded) with hover animations.
NEVER use emojis (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Kursi berhasil dipilih', 'Bukti pembayaran diunggah').
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
